pages.title: A second life · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy afternoon in an old part of Boston. Ana walks slowly because one shoe is broken. The heel came off near the bus stop. She sees a tiny shop with a wooden sign. The sign says Shoe Repair. An older man looks up from his work table.
“Good afternoon. How can I help you?” says Mr. Silva. “My shoe is broken. The heel came off.” says Ana. “Let me see. Yes, I can fix it.” says Mr. Silva.

pages.title: A second life · 3/3
paragraphs: “When can I pick them up?” says Ana. “Come back on Wednesday at noon.” says Mr. Silva. Mr. Silva puts the shoes on a shelf and writes her name. Ana takes a small paper with the price. She walks home in a pair of old sneakers. On Wednesday, she returns at noon. Her shoes look almost new. A good repair gives old things a second life.
